item.title: Fly tipping opposite my house at 31 Kidbrooke Grove, SE3 0LE., 5th August
item.description:
Someone has dumped various boxes filled with rubbish on the pavement next to a tree and and opposite my house. Inside the boxes are further cardboard boxes that have been broken down and then placed inside. It almost looks like rubbish from a shop. I have no idea where this has come from but it has been sitting on the pavement since at least yesterday if not before. Perhaps Greenwich Council could arrange for someone to remove it before the foxes and animals tear it asunder and everything blows up and down the road. Thank you

item.title: Yellow lines are worn out and covered by leaves, 5th August
item.description:
My 3 words panic.beast.drain. There is a break in the parking which is double yellow lines. This is to provide pull in for traffic to flow as large vehicles and buses use this road. Cars are parking on the double yellow lines leaving traffic unable to pass. The yellow lines have been reported by my husband 3 times by telephone but nothing has been done. To fix the problem, sweep the road regularly, repaint the yellow lines and monitor with parking officers regularly.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Watery Lane, Longlands, Greater London

item.title: Between 16 and 18 Oxford Road, 5th August
item.description:
Dumped bags and suitcases with clothes spilling onto the pavement need to be removed as soon as possible. It is not acceptable for people to leave rubbish of any kind on our streets. If it is left unattended, it only encourages more dumping and further deterioration of the area. We all have a responsibility to keep our neighbourhood clean, safe, and well cared for. Prompt removal and enforcement will help maintain respect for the community and discourage future fly-tipping. Thank you.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Oxford Road, London
Report on FixMyStreet

Another man fell off his scooter 2 minutes before, was badly injured and had to get an ambulance. Needs a sign asap The cone has been put as a temporary measure.
